fuente.titulo: Pope Leo XIV undergoes successful lung surgery

titular: Pope Leo XIV undergoes successful lung surgery
bajada: Doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung at Gemelli Hospital, Vatican says
caption: Pope Leo XIV has undergone surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital, where doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung, the Holy See Press Office confirmed. The operation followed the detection of a small, localized nodule reported earlier this week. Source: Vatican News, October 13, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Exterior of Gemelli Hospital in Rome at dusk, illuminated windows, a Vatican flag visible in the upper right third, empty foreground and left side.
